preconditions.description: The magic string T has length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in T)
preconditions.description: String T consists only of lowercase English letters.
The number of bouquets N is an integer between 1 and 600 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of distinct decorations.

postconditions.expression: output_count == len(set(tuple(sorted((tuple((b, i) for i, b in enumerate(arr))), tuple((b, (N - 1 - i) % N) for i, b in enumerate(arr)))) for arr in all_valid_decorations))
postconditions.description: The output count equals the number of equivalence classes of valid decorations under cyclic shifts and reversed cyclic shifts, where a valid decoration is a sequence of N palindromic substrings of T.
